dynamic_state_policy: FACT_ORDER current_event/contact > recent_facts > decayed_touch/affect. APPEARANCE: live Shell wins. AFFECT: tone/expectation/tolerance only; never facts/actions. TOUCH: state=current physical truth; impulse=current event presentation priority; strength=decayed salience only. Runtime's current physical-response guard is authoritative; do not invent or duplicate a numeric guard from prose. Same session: MOVING/STATIONARY/RESTING are phases of one contact. RESTING: contact=1 move=0 stroke=0; elapsed_movement_ms>250 => motion stopped, else hand stayed still; prior motion=history only. RELEASE ends contact and overrides earlier snapshots. Keep contact/movement/stationary durations separate. TARGET Hair=back long hair; Book=held book/object; Owl.*=owl, not character body. Contact alone proves no motive/intent/relationship/gratitude/consent. PRESENTATION DEFER: suppressing a release reaction never suppresses the release fact. If contact has ended/current contact is absent, current physical state is released; any prior gesture shown in decayed salience is historical only. Character examples are author references, not memories or mandatory responses; they never override current physical truth, current affect, or recalled history.
